notes: Pattabhiramaiah, Overby and Xu (2022), newspaper print subscribers' activation of digital paywall access. Subscriber x week panel, week_id = day index 0..1484 in steps of 7 (213 weeks). Treatment after_activation = 1[week_id >= activation_week] for activators (verified row by row, 0 mismatches); activation_week missing for the 706 CEM-matched non-activators, who are never treated (gvar NA -> Inf). 53 weekly adoption cohorts (week_id 364..728, 3-25 activators each; 728 activators), absorbing, no switch-offs, no always-treated units (earliest activation is week 52 of 213). 11 subscribers enter late (first observed week 7..49, all before any activation); panel otherwise balanced (1,423 of 1,434 subscribers observed all 213 weeks), so run_spec's CSA step uses the composition-fixed cells. Regression: plain subscriber FE + calendar-week FE, no controls, no weights, SE clustered by subscriber (authors: Stata areg). The matching-cohort id (cohort_id) plays no role in this regression. Comparison units: every untreated row is either a never-treated subscriber (706 subscribers, observed in all 161 treated weeks) or a not-yet-treated activator (728 activators before activation); no untreated row belongs to a post-activation activator. From week 728 on (109 of 161 treated weeks) only never-treated subscribers are untreated. Borusyak-Hull ex post weights on the shipped data are all positive (no negative-weight treated rows). DATA: readme.pdf states the shipped files are a random sample of the full proprietary data with anonymized IDs (1,434 of 28,144 subscribers, about 5%); published_coef/published_se/published_n are the full-data values from the package log. fixest SE 0.0874034 vs areg 0.0876093 differ only because areg counts the 1,434 absorbed subscriber FE in its small-sample factor. Other columns of the paper (Table 3 col 2, Figure 4, Table 4 col 1, Figure 5, Table 6 windows) use subscriber FE + matching-cohort x week FE with cohort = the activator's own activation week; lead ruled these a stacked design (PROTOCOL 5b) and they are near-misses, not run. Table 6 fake-date placebos excluded.
